_comment: Written by the Security Review persona. The pre-tag CI job reads this to decide whether a release is covered by a current audit. Do not hand-edit.
open_findings: MEDIUM: pre-tag gate cannot distinguish 'no open findings' from 'could not check' (query failure returns 0; label AND misses security issues lacking a priority label)
MEDIUM: repo default_workflow_permissions=write and can_approve_pull_request_reviews=true; zis-readme-check.yml has no permissions block
MEDIUM: artifact verification (attestation/checksum) appears only in release notes, not in the member-facing install guide
LOW: collaboration card interpolates status/priority/token unescaped while neighbouring values use esc()
notes: First full design review under the taxonomy. Delta since the previous record (bebbb15) was one commit: the security tooling itself (#107).

Verified live this review: release environment still has required reviewer shawn-tsanet; release.yml permissions:{} with per-job opt-in; both release actions SHA-pinned; SDK SRI exact-version pin and declared hash matches the artifact the CDN serves now; no embedded credentials; credential settings secure:true; domainWhitelist present; gate exit-code branching correct for 0/1/2/3.
Escaping verified present and applied at the two highest-risk render sites (collaboration summary/partner, note bodies) via esc(); adminNote uses an allowlist sanitizeHtml().
NOT re-probed this session: inbound webhook ingress authentication (relied on the closed #90 disposition rather than a fresh probe). Environment-reviewer and SRI checks are point-in-time.
Tracked, not re-raised: v1 endpoint usage sunsetting 2027-01-01 (#101); durable audit trail (#96); note direction (#98).
